policy_input_contract.internal_reference: norm_clip(-Kp*(p-p_target),v_max); recompute at each state; no target differentiation
policy_input_contract.error_mode_interpretation: inference input intervention on an absolute-velocity-trained policy
order: copy and replace velocity in error mode only
frozen saved observation normalization and clipping if present

reference_velocity.circle: r*theta_dot*[-sin(theta),cos(theta),0]; theta_dot=omega*(1-cos(pi*s/ramp))/2 in ramp, omega afterwards
reference_velocity.step: zero for regulation targets; no impulse
reference_velocity.boundary: CIRCLE/HOLD velocity discontinuity; right-phase value, no spike
reference_velocity.timing: position and velocity use the same case time offset; input at t, metrics at t+dt

limitations: Same-model/seed repetitions are determinism checks, not independent training runs.
Ground start z=0.02 can immediately violate the unchanged min_altitude=0.2 guard.
Historical training metadata without a checkpoint hash is path-associated, not cryptographic proof.
